sentences.text: MAIN CASE: W.P.No.4049 of 2024  PROCEEDING SHEET Sl.No.
Office  DATE ORDER Note 1. 15.02.2024 BKM, J  Heard the learned counsel for the  petitioner.
The learned Government Pleader for  Endowments takes notice for the respondent Nos.1 to 3.
The learned Standing Counsel takes notice for the 4th respondent.

The learned counsel for the petitioner is permitted to take out personal notice to the 5th respondent and proof of service shall be filed within a period of three (03) weeks from today.
List on 14.03.2024.
This writ petition is filed questioning the proceedings of the 2nd respondent dated 15.11.2023 granting exemption to the 4th respondent-temple under Sections 15, 29, 57 & 65 of the A.P.C &
H.R.I and Endowments Act 30/87 for a period of five (5) years and handing over the temple management to the 5th respondent.

The impugned proceedings of the 2nd respondent clearly mentioned that the said temple is endowed with an extent of Ac.17.59 cents of land out of it, Ac.4.80 cents is given towards the general and Ac.5.69 cents is given towards the specific purpose of the temple and the land in an extent of Ac.7.10 cents was acquired under land acquisition and Rs.4,43,040/- was paid towards compensation and this amount was deposited in the shape of Fixed deposit.

It was also observed that the father of the petitioner was declared as the Founder Family Member to the specific endowment attached to the subject temple and he filed C.M.A.No.578 of 2019 before this Court in the matter of handing over of the land to an extent of Ac.5.69 cents given towards the specific purpose to the applicant therein.

As the said applicant therein expired, his son got G Satish Babu vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12009484/
1 impleaded as the party to the said C.M.A., who is none other than the petitioner herein.

entities.text: G Satish Babu vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As the entire impugned proceedings of the 2nd respondent does not disclose the handing over of management of specific endowment to an extent of Ac.5.69 cents to the 5th respondent along with the 4th respondent-temple, at this stage, it cannot be interfered with.

However, it is made clear that, subject to outcome of the C.M.A.No.578 of 2019 on the file of this Court, the petitioner is at liberty to make appropriate representation to the 2nd respondent for modification of the orders if any.
The learned counsel for the petitioner also submits that, no notice was given to the petitioner before passing the impugned proceedings of the 2nd respondent dated 15.11.2023.
BKM, J PGT G Satish Babu vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh
